description: The file defines a Java class 'PackingServices' that provides static methods for managing packing operations within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for adding packing lines, bulk packing, adjusting package sequences, clearing packages, and calculating shipping charges, among other packing-related functionalities. The class interacts with a 'PackingSession' object and performs various utility operations related to shipment packing.

classes.name: PackingServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing packing operations such as adding lines, bulk packing, packaging sequences, and calculation of shipping costs within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addPackLine
methods.description: Adds or updates a packing line with specified product details, quantity, weight, and instructions in a packing session.

methods.name: packBulk
methods.description: Performs bulk packing operations based on provided selection, product, quantity, package, and weight information, capable of handling multiple packages per line.

methods.name: incrementPackageSeq
methods.description: Returns the next available package sequence number from the packing session.

methods.name: clearLastPackage
methods.description: Clears the last package in the current packing session and returns the next package sequence number.

methods.name: clearPackLine
methods.description: Removes a specific pack line identified by order, item, ship group, product, inventory, and package ID.

methods.name: clearPackAll
methods.description: Clears all packing lines in the current packing session.

methods.name: calcPackSessionAdditionalShippingCharge
methods.description: Calculates and sets the additional shipping charge for the current packing session based on package weights and shipment parameters.

methods.name: completePack
methods.description: Completes the packing process, finalizing shipment details, calculating totals, and optionally forcing completion.

methods.name: setSessionPackageWeights
methods.description: Sets weights for each package in the packing session and computes the total shippable weight.

methods.name: setSessionShipmentBoxTypes
methods.description: Assigns box types to packages within the packing session.
